features.text: GetSupportedFileFormats: Retrieves supported file formats list (GET /comparison/formats)
Comparisons: Compares source and target documents and returns a link to saved result (POST /comparison/comparisons)
PostChanges: Retrieves a list of changes between source and target documents (POST /comparison/changes)

PutChanges: Retrieves a list of changes between source and target documents supplied directly in the request body
as multipart/form-data. (PUT /comparison/changes)
PutChangesDocument: Accepts or rejects changes to the resultant document and returns a link to saved result (PUT /comparison/updates)
GetRevisions: Get list of DOCX document revisions. (POST /comparison/revisions)
ApplyRevisions: Accepts or rejects revisions in DOCX document (PUT /comparison/revisions)
Preview: Creates a preview images of document pages and returns an array of links to saved result (POST /comparison/preview)
